title: prepare-npm-package --out can recursively delete an unbounded path
description: tools/prepare-npm-package.mjs resolves caller-provided --out and then runs rm(outDir, { recursive: true, force: true }) with no containment check. Passing ., the repo root, a parent, home, or a symlinked path can delete real trees before packaging.
acceptanceCriteria: Release packaging rejects unsafe outDir values before deletion, including cwd, repo root, repo ancestors, filesystem root, home, and symlink escapes.
Only an approved staging/temp directory or the default release package path can be recursively removed.
Regression tests cover unsafe --out values and one valid staging directory.
